results.name: All real signups begin without operator privileges
Three independent accounts create fifteen real reports without bypassing per-account limits
Anonymous list, detail and review requests are denied with 401
A channel owner cannot read or review even a report targeting their own channel
A normal account has no operator report management menu
Direct operator navigation gives a normal user no report rows or details
An existing Redis session observes the explicit database operator grant
Real two-row cursor pages return all fifteen fixtures once without duplicates
List and detail expose no emails, credentials or tokens, and private review notes stay out of list rows
Combined server query, status and reason filters select only matching real reports
The operator session exposes report management in the profile menu
List 503 is a retryable error rather than a misleading empty state
List retry displays the fifteen stored reports without fixture or preview substitutions
UI search, status and reason filters persist in the URL and survive reload
Handle search submits to the server and selects reports for the requested channel
Rendered rows reveal no emails and channel links open with safe relation attributes
Operator filters and report rows fit the 390px viewport
Operator filters and report rows fit the 320px viewport
Detail 503 shows no stale report body or editable review form
Detail retry opens the selected real report with the expected initial transition
Terminal review requires a note and focuses the note before any write
Review PATCH 503 preserves the selected transition, note and open dialog
Pending review locks its controls and Escape, Enter or resubmit cannot close or duplicate it
Actual received-to-reviewing update persists its version, note and server-selected operator
Reviewing-to-resolved persists once and the closed report has no editable review form
The terminal review note survives a full browser reload
Received-to-dismissed persists an independent terminal outcome
Actual stale-version 409 preserves the unsaved note and requires explicit refresh without auto-resubmitting
Explicit conflict refresh loads the latest server version and re-enables a deliberate next action
Report details and review controls fit the 390px viewport
Report details and review controls fit the 320px viewport
Permission revocation clears existing private rows and dialog and removes operator navigation
The same existing API session immediately loses DB-backed operator authority
The rejected revoked write leaves the previously stored version and note unchanged
Report review changes only moderation records and does not fabricate a channel ban
No browser runtime or request interception errors
